decisions.reason: Although submarine interior lighting is relatively distant from the core range, its maritime customer fit and the firm’s prior development and market commitment make management likely to continue a bit longer rather than admit a niche misstep.

Explosion-proof industrial luminaires are strongly aligned with the firm’s industrial lighting business and LED innovation path, and the added 2019 replacement kit signals continuing commitment that supports persistence.

The designer task light is close to the established offer and was publicly relaunched as a popular product, so prior visibility and investment make management inclined to retain it unless results clearly worsen.

As a close-to-core office luminaire introduced only in 2019, it fits the firm’s energy-efficient professional lighting strategy and is still likely to benefit from management’s desire to justify recent launch investments.

The premium pendant luminaire is also close to the core portfolio and recent enough for disappointing performance to be explained as temporary, which under escalation of commitment favors keeping it on the market.
